title: THE ARENA's road cleared wide by SOL's swath and the automated gunship's road MK-9s, and no emerge blob for the Nih-Dairia: the drop's rock chunks thrown from the lip instead
context: Owner, 2026-10-23 10:40 JST: '2) we clear a path with both SOL firing more aggressively AND the gunship dropping nukes to destroy a large path at least 2 cells wide for the tank to speed up to full speed without being impeded. 3) there's a giant green blob preceding the large boss, I know that we use that for the smaller waves of enemies, but it does not work when scaled to a large boss.' Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-23-arena-road-and-blob-design.md (three decisions: the swath, the road MK-9s, no blob for her). Found first: THE ARENA's row has had no wave since note 4 (2026-10-19), so the arena breach's one record is the mother, and src/fx/enemy-step.js gave every record risen at a breach's own cell the lip's blob at its drawn size in its tint (reed: ALARM_HUES.green): the giant green blob was hers. The boss-emerge pull-out (src/domain/boss-emerge.js) runs only in the labs; in the game she rises through the generic EMERGENCE pop. The MK-9 already took rocks: strike-console's breakWalls breaches every BLOCKED cell in its blast through breachWallCell + rebuildAfterBreach, the same pair SOL's burn uses (laser-arsenal breakCells), and terrain ROCK is BLOCKED in dungeon.tags.
outcome: Branch arena-road from overnight-2026-10-23, three commits, unpushed. (3) bossWaves marks the row's boss entry `boss`; enemy-step gives that record no blob and, as she breaks the surface, throws the drop's 24 rock chunks from the lip toward her: the chunk burst lifted out of src/fx/feids-heat.js into src/fx/rock-chunks.js (chunkAt with a ring, createRockChunks shared with the drop's touchdown, createRockBursts on the unit sphere with the planet's curve), BOSS_RUBBLE.scale 3, kept 60 s; state().boss.blob/rubble. The waves keep their blobs. (1) src/domain/arena.js roadSwath: each kept road cell's rock and its rock flanks within ARENA.road.width 1 (three wide), a one-cell corridor's first flank `need`; boss-run asks road rocks, then needed flanks, then the rest, a flank from clear + 1 (7.5 cells); every 4 -> 2, burn 2.5 -> 1.6 renewed once on a rock still standing, aheadMetres 100 -> 140. (2) boss-run roadNukeTarget: of the next 20 road cells at least nukeSafeCells + blastCells + 2 + the hull's top speed x the MK-9's travel (34.15 cells) ahead, the one with the most rocks in the blast; gunship-auto `road` drops an MK-9 on it every travel + reload (the arena's guns now apply in beacon; auto-support's pilot bag kept its guns getter live), friends nukeSafeCells + 2 clear, on screen and facing the hull; a pile of at least nukePile / roadWeight 25 still wins the pass. --arena-drive (look 3, from cell 49499, 147.9 cells out): the hole at 52.4 s against the base's 84.0 s, the hull's mean 150.8 of 202.8 km/h (74 %, peak 201; about 172 km/h, 85 %, after the base's exit), 190 road cells entered and none one wide, four road MK-9s with 307 rock cells in their blasts, the hull never nearer than 14.66 cells to a landing.
alternatives: The spec's 10.5-cell minimum alone for the road MK-9: the hull drives at its target at up to 5.6 cells/s through the round's 4.2 s fall and would be inside the blast at landing; the hull's travel is added.

Pure road order for the swath: a near flank ahead of a far road rock could keep the beam until the road rock reached the guard; road rocks go first, then the cells that make a one-wide corridor two wide.
A second copy of the drop's chunk code for the boss: the spec forbids it; the burst is one module now.

Driving the arena-drive measure with the lure autopilot (the 'lure's' top speed): the lure walks cell to cell at params.speed with no run-up, so its mean is its top regardless of the corridor; the measure is the WASD run-up the owner's 'speed up to full speed' names.
Taking the gunship off the arena's station to follow the road: kept on station (2026-10-18) so it is over the arena when she rises; its road drops fly from there.
evidence: npm test 303 programs, npm run check, npm run architecture (td-tab 5,324 under 5,450), npm run build on the final tree

--arena PASS (her entrance: blob false, rubble true); --arena-fight PASS; --nest-guards PASS (a 6-body wave at a back breach, 6 with a blob); --arena-drive PASS: see outcome; burns' end lead >= 4.88 cells, every planned rock burned

Same driver (DRIVE_LOOK 3) on the base: 84.0 s, mean 101.3 km/h (50 %), peak 155; look 1: base 88.7 s / 106.2 km/h, the swath alone 108.4 s / 100.9 (25 s pinned at the base's exit), swath + nukes 75.9 s / 129.1
--nest-guards' chase was red on overnight-2026-10-23 itself (the Reed starts 1.49 cells from the hull and the loop ends at once with 0 moves); the move check accepts a Reed already within 1.5 cells

Open: the 80 % mean is not reached (74 %: the base's exit and the run-up); the boss's rubble has not been looked at in a screenshot; one run wedged the WASD driver 140 s in a corner of the base's clearing by cell 3656, the harness now turns the hull round after three back-outs
